messages:
Raj (PM): Quick heads-up 30s we prep the public MVP rollout: recent perf run showed a 12-18% tail latency regression once embedding-cache and streaming attachments land together. Need to decide scope cuts vs more infra work. Short sync?
Lila (Eng): Saw it too. Root cause looks like cache thrash between KV refreshes and the new streaming encoder buffer. When both features enabled, we get more concurrent small writes + long-lived streams -> spike in p95.
Tomas (SRE): Risk: if we ship both, some regions exceed latency SLO and we may trigger automatic throttles which will look like errors to customers. Ops recommends removing streaming attachments from public MVP.
Mei (Design): UX concern: streaming attachments is a visible experience; removing it affects marketing demos. Can we offer a faux-stream in UI (progress indicator) until v1?
Owen (Support): Two pilots asked specifically for attachments. They said streaming isn't required, they can accept batched upload + notify. That might be an easy compromise.
Raj (PM): Proposed decision: cut streaming attachments from public MVP, keep batch attachments (non-streaming) + optimistic UI progress. Move streaming attachments and aggressive embedding-cache tuning to v1. Also deprioritize function/tool complex calling (the advanced async tooling path) for MVP; keep sync function call surface for partner pilots.
Lila (Eng): I can scope the changes: 
- Remove streaming handler (small revert + config flip) ~ 1d, test + canary 2d.
- Keep batch attachment flow minimal code path.
- Move async-tooling to v1; leave sync function-call shim with logs.
Tomas (SRE): Ops plan: revert streaming on public-mvp branch, keep it enabled only in Dedicated and pilot flags. Start canary after revert: 3 regions 5% for 48h, monitor p95, CPU, and queue depth.
Mei (Design): I'll prepare the progressive loading UI mock and copy: "Uploads processed; enable streaming in v1 for instant updates". Will drop copy in next PR.
Owen (Support): I'll pre-write customer-facing note and pilot FAQ: explain streaming delay and pilot exception path.
Raj (PM): Action items: 
- Raj: update roadmap + public MVP one-pager (today).
- Lila: PR to flip streaming off in public branch (by EOD tomorrow).
- Tomas: canary plan + dashboards (post-PR).
- Mei: progressive UX/CTA and demo fallback (tomorrow).
- Owen: customer comms + pilot guidance (by Fri).
Lila (Eng): Also: quantify perf gain if we postpone embedding-cache change. If it's >10% we keep it out of MVP; otherwise we reconsider. I'll run perf numbers and post here.
Tomas (SRE): release-bot: please hold the wider rollout until we have p95 < 300ms on canary.
release-bot: Canary hold configured; global rollout paused pending canary metrics.
Raj (PM): If canary looks good we can re-evaluate lifting any holdbacks. We'll do a checkpoint Wed 10am to review metrics and finalize the public MVP cutlist.
Mei (Design): Minor ask: can we keep a small in-console badge for "pilot-enabled streaming" so SEs can see who has it? Helps support.
Lila (Eng): Will add a tenant-flag response field; docs in PR.
Owen (Support): Noted. I'll add a troubleshooting snippet for attachment timeouts.
Raj (PM): Thanks team. This preserves launch reliability and keeps pilot revenue paths open. :white_check_mark:
